changeinfo.changes:
『Ragnarok Odyssey ACE』


Updating Information
  • Addition of "Jester Hat" and "Patrol Lights" headgear
[Fixes to Bugs]
  • Fixed an issue regarding the intended amount of Prismatic Dust being dropped by the Domovoi Ranger enemy.
  • In Control Types 2 and 4, adjusted the functionality of the L button so that Cancel Lock-On no longer interferes with using an ACE Skill.
  • Fixed the issue regarding the action commands not working during the Communication feature.
  • Various other bugs have been fixed.

『Ragnarok Odyssey ACE』


Updating Information
  • Addition of a new stage, Prison of the Gods
  • Addition of new quests
  • Addition of new weapons
  • Addition of new outfits
  • Addition of new ACE skills
  • Addition of Online Services features
    • Expansion on Norn Exchange features
    • Expansion on Quest Counter features
    • Being able to buy Emperium Shards from Norn Exchange.
  • Change in display for My Orders
  • Addition of new features for BGM Select
  • Addition of new DLC data
[Game Balance Changes]
  • The drop amount of Prismatic Dust after defeating a Domovoi Ranger has been adjusted.
[Fixes to Bugs]
  • Fixed various issues in the Mercenary Book
  • Fixed various other issues.
